name: wallabag
title: wallabag
description: Read-later service: save an article from the browser or phone and read its text later without the clutter, with tags, annotations, full-text search and export to EPUB or PDF. After deploying, sign in as wallabag with the password wallabag and change that password right away.

variables.name: WALLABAG_URL
variables.label: Public address
variables.description: The address people open, like https://wallabag.example.com. The pages load their styles from it, so a wrong one leaves the page bare. Leave empty and DCS uses this deploy's route, or this server's address and the port above

variables.name: WALLABAG_SECRET
variables.label: App secret
variables.description: Signs sessions and forms. Leave empty and DCS generates one on deploy

variables.name: WALLABAG_REGISTRATION
variables.label: Open registration
variables.description: Lets anyone who can open the page make an account

auth_note: Not put behind Authelia: the phone apps, browser extensions and e-readers sign in directly (the deploy sheet can still protect it)
